Agreement affected by such decision, whereupon
the parties agree immediately to negotiate a sub-
stitute for the invalidated portion thereof.

ARTICLE 50
FULLY BARGAINED PROVISIONS

50-1. This Agreement represents and incorpo-
rates the complete and final understanding and
settlement by the parties on all bargainable issues
for the life of this Agreement, and neither party
shall be required to negotiate on any subject unless
they mutually agree to do so.

ARTICLE 51
MISCELLANEOUS

51-1. There shall be no reprisals of any kind
taken by the Board, its servants, agents, or em-
ployees against any teacher or member of the JCEA
by reason of membership in the JCEA or participa-
tion of its activities or by reason of his-her em-
ployment and/or his-her school-connected activities.

51-2. The President of the JCEA shall be per-
mitted to attend to Association affairs to the same
degree as was true prior to the 1978-80 school year,
and shall continue to be granted adequate office
facilities.

51-3. The Association agrees that teachers will,
if requested, meet with parents during the evening
not more than twice during the school year exclusive
of the traditional open-house practice. One of said
three (3) meetings shall be held after school hours
and the other two (2) shall be held in the evening.

ARTICLE 52
DURATION

52-1. The provisions of this Agreement shall be
effective as of September 1, 1978, and shall remain
in full force and effect until August 31, 1980, subject
to the right of the Board and Association to nego-
tiate for a modification of this Agreement as pro-
vided in Article 3 of said Agreement.

52-2. All present conditions covered by any pre-
vious Agreement and those items now in effect as
regular employer-employee practice shall remain in
effect unless otherwise provided for in the 1978-80
Contract or unless changed hereinafter by mutual
consent.

45
